Execute `scripts/roo-key-sync.sh` environment variable synchronization across `.vscode` and `.cursor`.

Test print stylesheet rendering for the SamDTU CME accreditation certificate via Playwright PDF emulation.
Verify zero unhandled browser console errors or failed network requests across the entire portal tree.

Validate Turnir production packaging script (`npm run pack`) creates valid `submission.zip`.
Verify GSD task board (`gsd/BOARD.md`) status and update active specifications.

Generate the Executive Master Dossier artifact summarizing completed work, active automations, and next autonomous cycles.
